title: Agentic QA
subtitle: How to ship fast with coding agents without shipping their bugs
description: A practical handbook for engineers who ship with coding agents. It shows why agents over-produce tests that cannot fail — mocking the code under test — and gives the fixes as things you can run: an executed example repository with an agent-style suite and a real one, break-it-on-purpose and mutation scripts, rules to paste into CLAUDE.md, a reviewer prompt, a UI campaign method, CI gates, and checklists.
